label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: endpoint = param (user input) reaches URL connection sink at L24. Loopback check only validates octets[0]==127, allowing bypass via public IPs (e.g., 8.8.8.8 has octets[0]=8). Resolved sink value is attacker-controlled user input that can reach arbitrary external hosts.

evidence.note: User param flows to endpoint, DNS resolves it, loopback check allows non-127.x IPs, connection made to http://+endpoint+/v1
